description: Agent Purchases: submit one purchase receipt (the buyer identity it names and its kind, the party it was paid for, the acting agent, merchant, category, amount, time and the credential paid with) and the delegation behind it (who delegated, to which agent, the merchants, categories and per-payment amount it allows, when it expires, how it is revoked and any revocation time). The signed report says whether the buyer identity on the receipt is the delegating business or person and the acting agent the delegated one, names an agent paying as itself, a receipt identity the delegation does not cover and a purchase after revocation, then every purchase outside the delegation’s merchants, categories or amount, an unscoped or expired delegation, a delegation that cannot be revoked and an agent paying with the business’s own key. Issuing a mandate is wever_delegated-authority, a delegation document’s own terms are wever_delegation-check and an agent identity record’s consistency is wever_agent-identity-check. Verdict pays_as_itself, not_delegated, delegation_gaps, identity_unverified or properly_delegated. POST /api/delegated-identity-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-purchases-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-purchases/.
